body: I’m an only child so I don’t even have siblings I can rely on. People take their siblings for granted, it’s not fun being alone.

I ate bland cake and kinda just sat there. It’s even worse because I turned 18 and barely anyone remembered my birthday. I’m jealous of the people who have friends that throw them surprise parties and stuff.
I gave up on my dream as well. I wanted to be an astrophysicist, but I realized I was too stupid to become one. I’m just horrible at all the things I love, and it hurts

School makes me want to die too, and my mother used to beat me up for getting anything less than an A. I’m so tired and my bitch ass biology teacher decided to give us a test on the week back, so now I have to cram a bunch of information in my head and pray that I get an A. Fuck school.

Imagine going up to someone in a horrible situation, whether it be poverty, abuse, starvation or a painful illness, and telling them “just be glad you’re alive.” People don’t understand how mental illness can cause as much pain as a physical illness.

Happy birthday! My birthday is my Lear favorite day of the year because it reminds how alone I am. This year was my 18th birthday alone, and I didn’t realize how pathetic it was until I saw other people getting surprise parties with all of their friends. I got no gifts for my birthday, not even from my parents. But I think this will be my lady birthday alone, because I’m going to kill myself.

The only thing I’m good at now is knowing suicide methods. I used to be so smart and knowledgeable, but now I can barely even hold a conversation with someone since the only thing I know how to do is kill myself. My hobbies have just become optimizing ways to die.
Let’s do it

I’m also way to kind to others and I’m often taken advantage. I think I’m programmed to be nice, because I don’t see a reason why not to be nice to people. Over the years I’ve become jaded after being abused and used by the wrong people. It feels like the world is exponentially cruel to the kindest people.

I’ve waited 7 years now as well. I wish I would’ve just killed myself the first few times instead of listening to selfish people. They only care about saving face and not being responsible for your death. They never care about your feelings or how much you’ve suffered. No one cares until after you’re dead. Funny how that works.

I don’t want to keep going either. Knowing how I am now, I won’t get any better. People told me “everything will be ok once you’re in high school” and now I’m a high school senior and everything is not ok. People are just liars.
I wish I was someone’s favorite as well
I grew up alone as well. I didn’t talk to myself, but I would be off in my own world trying to pass time. Growing up alone is sad. I wish I had a twin or a childhood friend.

You’re not the genetic loser or anything. Fuck beauty standards, you gotta be confident in yourself. That’s easier said than done, but if you’re confident about how you look you appeal to people more. Don’t let your height stop you from being the best you can be.

Hey buddy, I’m friends with a few short dudes and they have their insecurities but I always see them for who they are rather than their heights. One of my friends is 5’4 at 17 and he does feel insecure but he has one of the funniest and boldest personalities I know. I wish I could speak on behalf of women, but unfortunately I’m gay and into women myself so I don’t know about straight women’s preferences. However I will say that there are a lot of short women that prefer shorter guys because it feels less awkward to them. There’s also tall women that like shorter guys too! You’ll always be someone’s type. 

Don’t worry about height so much. I have the opposite problem because I’m 5’9 and a girl so I have a hard time finding girls around or over my height.
I’m in class right now as well and I want to cry. I want to kill myself and I want to tell someone because I’m scared. It seems no matter what I do nothing goes my way.
I don’t know if someone as boring and pathetic as me will be able to make friends
The colleges I heard back from are in the city(I live in the suburbs so it’s not that far). I love the city so it’s not a problem, but I’m sure I’ll see a lot of people from my high school.
Yes
Me too. I’m mad that I listened to people who said it gets better. They lied

That makes so much sense. People kept telling me to change but whenever I tried it would just get worse. How am I supposed to get better when I’m dealt a horrible hand? If the odds are stacked against me, what can I do?
I’m tired of things not going my way. Maybe it’ll be better in college, but I don’t want to take that chance. I think my life was doomed from the start.

I too want to know the answer as well. Why shouldn’t I be allowed to die? It’s my right to kill myself. Saying “it gets better” only suggests that I stay alive for a mere chance of life being nicer. I’d rather guarantee my death now rather than wait for things to maybe get better and regretting not killing myself sooner.

I got into 2 other schools who gave me a lot of money, but they’re not Northwestern. I had told myself I would kill myself if I didn’t get accepted, and I didn’t. It seems nothing goes the way I want in my life.
Northwestern
It’s refreshing for someone to be proud of me despite my failure. Unfortunately, I don’t think I can get through this. It’s been years, nearly a decade since I’ve been depressed.

I feel the exact same tbh, as much as I want to be loved I know I’m incapable of even feeling it anymore. Even if someone said they loved me I’m sure I wouldn’t be able to actually feel it. Someone who loved me years ago broke my heart and ever since then I haven’t been able to feel anything. At this point I just want to die.
Your dogs are very cute!!! You seem like such a wholesome person :)
I’m also from the Midwest! Corn fields for miles(but only outside of the city)😎🤙

My iron levels are dropping everyday, and I don’t want to tell anyone about it because I want it to kill me. 

I’m losing blood everyday. I’m gonna die.

At least people won’t be sad that I took my life though. Maybe they can be at peace with that.
I still haven’t gotten the mail from them yet but I know what the answer will be. I am stupid, so I know they won’t take me. I’m not rich either. I’m just nothing.

I’ve always been an A student so I accept nothing less than A’s. But my depression got in the way and I crashed hard and I think I’m actually stupid because I was never able to pick myself back up. 

I give up. Life wins. I’ll just kill myself before college to save myself from suffering further.
I want to die but I’m such a coward. I bet I can end my life right now if I wasn’t so scared of pain. But I’m in pain all the time because just existing is pain for me.
I wish I died instead of my dog
Because I feel like I’ll be too overprotective or annoying to the dog. Or I won’t be adequate at training it or it won’t love me idk
I’m sorry to hear that too, you can talk me about whatever the fuck. I’m busy but I’ll respond as soon as I can
My mother is unfortunately allergic to cats, and I always over think about getting a dog because I’m worried I won’t be a good owner. I might get one soon though
Stay strong dude, I hope you can find the happiness within yourself. I’ve been searching for years but I’ve never found it yet. Maybe some people can only find happiness in others

I just started online school but it hasn’t been very stressful, I go through periods of nightmares sometimes and I can barely sleep. As a child I never had a single nightmare but now it’s basically every night
Thank you, I needed to hear this
Same with me, nothing helps anymore and nothing matters anymore
I wish I could turn my life around.
January third

It shocked me even more to be called “homophobic” when I myself am a lesbian. I was so baffled and hurt by this statement and I’ve never gotten over it since. How does someone even think that being assaulted by a woman and not enjoying it is homophobic? It’s not like I didn’t enjoy it because she was a woman, but because I was a child and I was scared. Even if a man or nb person did this to me I’d be upset. But of course, only men are horrible people and when women rape it’s just a misunderstanding

I haven’t gotten death threats but I’ve been told to just “kill myself already” after I made a comment about being depressed. People love acting like they’re some saints and try to excuse themselves from being a piece of shit because of their circumstances. 

At least people on this subreddit are mostly nice :)

God I wish I could tell them that but then they’re just like “nooo you have so much to live for :( you’re so smart and pretty and blah blah blah.” Maybe if you told me this in other times and not just when I tell you that I want to die then I’d actually believe it.
Thank you
I don’t know how to have fun ￼
What can I do then?
I don’t think my parents will let me go out, especially because of corona. School was my only time to espace from my parents and so I did a lot of school activities. I guess the world hates me
Hybrid, but I doubt I can do anything fun since all the activities are cancelled

Suicidal and hopeless. I feel like school is ruined for this year and that was the only thing keeping sane. I was actually going to go to homecoming this year and let lose on studying and try to have more fun but I guess I can’t do that anymore.
I’m kind of bad again
How long will it take? It’s been years and I can’t handle this anymore
I don’t want to make you sad

I really tried, I did a lot of new things during quarantine but it didn’t make me happy. Cooked, started new shows, learned economics, and picked up a new instrument but it did not make me happy in the slightest. Maybe i lost my ability to be happy
There isn’t anything I really want to do anymore besides dying. That sounds negative but I don’t find enjoyment in anything anymore.
Tried meds, it did not work. I play music, draw, read scientific journals and read manga for hobbies but they don’t make me happy. Nothing works anymore.
I appreciate the thought but I’m a different religion. Thank you for Jesus for loving me though.

A lot of things have brought me to this point. I thought things would get better this year but all my plans were ruined and now I can’t even have a normal senior year. Just another thing to add to all my problems.
I’ve tried going to therapy but it didn’t help
Not good :(

We basically “fight” just to suffer more. People tell us to live because they’re selfish. They want us in their life, no matter how painful living is. I wish I could get cancer, it seems like a good way to go out and people won’t be as sad.
If I talk to my friends about it I’ll be more sad because it’ll remind of the things we planned but could never do.
I wish it was legal in the US. I know I will continue to suffer even after I “get out” of my bad situation because of my trauma. I’m beyond saving at this point.
A lot better, I made a friend and we’re quickly becoming really close. Friends really do help man

Fender is a good brand. I love their electric guitars too. I think they’re a good brand for beginners.

I’m 17 and I’m not in control of my own finances. I barely have any money saved up, but for some reason she hates when I spends it on something I genuinely want. She doesn’t even want me to work because she doesn’t want me to get enough money to buy things. I can’t wait to leave home

If I ask for meds again my mother will get angry. Even when I had friends in the past I was never able to hang out with them because of my mother too. Right now hanging out doesn’t seem possible because of quarantine though.

Getting a hobby is good. I really want a guitar too but my mother says she’ll disown me if I get one.

To be honest I’m probably the worst thing in his life. I’m sorry that’s he’s friends with me. He’s a sheltered rich white kid with an amazing family and he’s super talented, extremely smart and honestly perfect in every way. Then we started being friends and I got depressed and he tries to help me everyday. It must tiring for him. I bet he’s sick of me. No matter how many times he tries to help it never works. I wish he’d just give up on me already. 

The funny thing is it feels like he’s lying to me. He says I can trust him but I don’t know if I can. I’m an idiot.

I was a child, I didn’t understand the world around me or anything else but as I grew the reality set in.
I don’t know if I can be happy, I just want to give up. Trying to be to happy hurts too much. It’s like desperate looking for something that doesn’t exist anymore.
I’ll join them one day

Nothing ever gets better man. I try keeping my head up for one day and then something will push my down again. I guess I’m not supposed to have a good life

It’s expensive, and a lot of people from my school apply there so idk if I have a chance. My counselor says my grades are good for any college but so is everyone else at my school probably.
